description: Place search, directions, isochrones & area analysis across 10 map providers. No API key to start.
name: io.github.geowire/geowire

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables the Google Maps Platform provider (BYOK). Without it, GeoWire runs OpenStreetMap-only with no key required.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables Yelp Fusion for US/Western business data — ratings, reviews, price, categories.
environmentVariables.name: YELP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional (free). Enables US Census demographics (population, median age, household income) for area analysis.
environmentVariables.name: CENSUS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables Foursquare global POI data — categories, photos, popularity.
environmentVariables.name: FOURSQUARE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a CSV of your own places to register as a priority provider.
environmentVariables.name: GEOWIRE_INTERNAL_CSV

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a geowire.config.yaml for advanced routing/budget/provider settings.
environmentVariables.name: GEOWIRE_CONFIG
